@@U02431@@
I order you by my staff, stay calm! Ah, but my help’s not needed now. They've come to life, these fearsome monsters! I see them spread their double pairs of wings! How quickly they've won the space! They shake their scaly jaws and fire spews forth! The crowd flies in every direction! Now there’s room.

@@U02432@@
(普路托斯 descends from the chariot.)

@@U02433@@
How regally he steps from the chariot! He signals; the dragons lift down the chest of gold with Avarice seated upon it. It rests now at his feet. A miracle has happened.

@@U02435@@
(To the BOY CHARIOTEER.)

@@U02436@@
Rid of this all-too-heavy burden, I set you free. Hurry off, now, to that realm that is uniquely yours. It is not here. Here we are surrounded by the confused, the ugly, the turbulent, the wild. Yours is a place where you can see with clarity, where you are yours alone, dependent only on yourself. There where beauty and goodness alone give delight— in solitude. Create your own world there!
translation:
@@U02431@@
我的工作人员命令你，保持冷静！啊，不过现在不需要我的帮助了。这些可怕的怪物复活了！我看到它们展开双对翅膀！他们多么快就赢得了这个空间！它们摇晃着鳞状的下巴，火焰喷涌而出！人群向四面八方飞去！现在有空间了。

@@U02432@@
（普路托斯从战车上下来。）

@@U02433@@
他从战车上走下来是多么威严啊！他发出信号；巨龙抬起金箱，贪婪坐在上面。它现在停在他的脚边。奇迹发生了。

@@U02435@@
（致战车男孩。）

@@U02436@@
摆脱了这太重的负担，我让你自由了。现在，快点前往那个属于你的独特领域吧。它不在这里。在这里，我们被混乱、丑陋、动荡和狂野所包围。你的地方是一个你可以看得清清楚楚的地方，在那里你是你自己的，只依赖于你自己。在那里，只有美丽和善良才能带来快乐——在孤独中。在那里创造你自己的世界！
